title: Microbiology, B.S. (Eberly College of Science)
notes: Pre-2024 curriculum, built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan and Program Requirements sections (fetched directly, not assumed identical to 2026). This is a genuinely different, older curriculum than MICRB-2026.json's -- the department did a real overhaul between the 2023-24 and 2024-25 catalogs that introduced the current 'options' structure (General Microbiology / Medical Microbiology) and the generic 'MICRB Elective List A/B/C' pools (see MICRB-2024.json's notes for the transition year). This 2022 edition instead names its electives directly: 'Select 4 of {MICRB 401, 410, 412, 415, 450} (11-12cr)', 'select 3-4cr lab from {BMB 445W, BMB 448, MICRB 422, MICRB 447}', 'select 6-7cr from {BMB 408, BMB 488, BMB 496, FDSC 408, or additional 400-level MICRB}', plus 'Supporting Courses: 8-10cr from a department-approved list' (labeled 'Department List C' in the printed Suggested Academic Plan itself). The exact membership of the last two pools isn't enumerated in the public bulletin text, so -- matching 2026's own documented convention for its unenumerated List A/B/C pools -- they remain generic 'MICRB 400-Level Elective' / 'Department List C' placeholder slots rather than match/open_elective picks; this plan instead names every course the archived Suggested Academic Plan itself names explicitly (MICRB 401, 421W, 450, 422, 447, and the 412-or-415 / 410-or-415 choices, BMB 428). Total credits: 125 (bulletin's own stated total), reconstructed exactly from the archived per-semester credit list (15/16/16/15/15.5/17/15.5/15). One real, specifically-confirmed credit-value difference from 2026: this catalog year's printed plan lists MICRB 450 at 2 credits (Fall Year 4: '2' + 'MICRB 400-level selections (5)' + BMB 428 (3) + Dept List C (4) + GHW (1.5) = 15.5, which only balances with MICRB 450 = 2), versus 3 credits in the current/2026 catalog data -- kept as printed for this year's file rather than silently normalized to 3. This year's plan also predates the PHYS 211 alternate (only PHYS 250/251, the calculus-based sequence, is offered) and the MATH 141/STAT 200/240/250 alternate (only MATH 141 is offered), and keeps ENGL 15 (Semester 1) and CAS 100A/B/C (Semester 2) as two separate Gen Ed Foundations requirements rather than 2026's single merged 'ENGL 15 (or CAS 100A/B/C)' item. Same MATH 3->4->21->22 real-prereq-chain fix as 2026 applied here too and for the same reason: catalog/prereq data (Backend/catalogs/*.json) is not versioned per catalog year in this app -- CHEM 110's real prereq (MATH 22, which needs MATH 21, which needs MATH 4, which needs MATH 3) is the same live scraped data underlying every catalog year's plan, so the identical gateway-course scaffold is required here as well, in the same Semester 1-4 positions. 'etm' marks the same Entrance-to-Major gateway courses as 2026 (CHEM 110, MATH 140, MICRB 201), matching this year's own bulletin text: 'at least a 2.00 cumulative GPA and a grade of C or better in each of CHEM 110, 111, 112, and MATH 140' before formal entrance.
